points.reason_en: The far side's volley goes straight into the net, so the near side wins the point.
points.reason_es: La volea del lado lejano se va directa a la red, así que punto para el lado cercano.

points.reason_en: Let: the serve clipped the net and landed in, so it's replayed and no point is scored.
points.reason_es: Let: el saque toca la red y entra, se repite y no hay punto.

points.reason_en: The near side's smash goes into the net, so the far side wins the point.
points.reason_es: El remate del lado cercano se va a la red, así que punto para el lado lejano.
